question: Jazz Chisholm Jr. To Hit 2+ HR on July 21, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if Jazz Chisholm Jr. hit 2 or more home runs in his MLB game(s) played on July 21, 2026, as recorded in the official MLB game log for that date.
- "No": Wins if Jazz Chisholm Jr. hit 0 or 1 home run across all MLB game(s) played on July 21, 2026, or if no game involving Chisholm was played on that date, as recorded in the official MLB game log for that date.

Clarifications:
- If Chisholm appeared in multiple games on July 21, 2026 (e.g., a doubleheader), his home run total is the combined count across all such games.
- Only home runs hit during the July 21, 2026 calendar date (ET game start) count; home runs from any other date do not count.
